'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / More Dangerous Than You Realize]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
